summary: Magnolia Oil & Gas Corp filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a $1 billion secondary offering of Class A common stock with an underwriter option for an additional $150 million. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The company is raising equity capital using an existing shelf registration statement. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is indicated. Proceeds will be general corporate purposes. The offering is subject to market conditions and underwriting closing procedures.
